facts.fact: Tech Review Africa reports that INSA experts developed the cyber drill platform entirely in-house, and it was used by 17 institutions in the 7th National Cyber Security Month.

The National ID Program says it has in-house technical capability and a strong in-house cybersecurity team behind Fayda.
